MONTEVIDEO 2026
The
most competitive
Final on the continent.
The 2026 CONMEBOL Libertadores Final is coming to Montevideo. The two best clubs in the competition will meet in pursuit of La Gloria Eterna. Register your interest to receive official information about ticket sales, purchase dates, and all event updates.

All about tickets for the Final
The Final will take place on November 28 at Estadio Centenario in Montevideo. The event will also feature a Libertadores Experience, with activities and special experiences to enjoy the Final beyond the stadium
Register to find out when official ticket sales for the CONMEBOL Libertadores 2026 Final begin and get ready to experience one of the most anticipated matches on the continent. Frequently asked questions
How can I get tickets to the Final?
Tickets for the 2026 CONMEBOL Libertadores Final will be sold through the official platform. Register your interest to receive information about ticket sale dates, stages, and purchase conditions.
Why should I register my interest?
By registering, you will receive official ticket sale updates and find out when the purchasing process opens.
When will tickets go on sale?
The ticket sale start date will be announced soon through CONMEBOL's official channels. We will also send this information by email to registered users.
Where can I buy tickets?
Tickets must be purchased exclusively through the official platform announced by CONMEBOL. We recommend that you do not purchase tickets from unauthorized sellers or websites.
How will I receive updates?
We will send updates to the email address associated with your registration. Make sure you enter your email address correctly and check your spam folder.
Does registering guarantee that I will be able to buy tickets?
No. Registering your interest does not constitute a purchase or reservation and does not guarantee ticket availability. Purchases will be subject to the applicable conditions and available inventory.
Do I need to register to buy tickets?
Registering allows you to receive official information in advance. The final purchase conditions and requirements will be announced before ticket sales begin.
How many tickets will I be able to buy?
The maximum number of tickets per person will be announced when the official ticket sale conditions are published.
What happens if my team does not reach the Final?
Your registration will remain valid, and you will continue to receive ticket information. You can decide whether to make a purchase once the finalists are confirmed.
Will accessible tickets be available?
Information about the availability of accessible tickets and the request process will be announced together with the official ticket sale conditions.
Where can I find official information?
All information will be available through CONMEBOL's official channels and on the CONMEBOL Libertadores Final page.
